title: Secondhand smoke
question: How many non-smokers breathe other people's tobacco smoke?
metric: Share of non-smokers exposed to tobacco smoke at home, at work or in other places (GBD estimate, age-standardized)
caveats: GBD modelled estimate from surveys of exposure; for a yes-or-no exposure the summary exposure value equals the share of people exposed.
Children are counted too; secondhand smoke in pregnancy and childhood is part of the burden.

source.citation: Global Burden of Disease Collaborative Network. Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (GBD 2023) Results. Seattle, United States: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME), 2024. Available from https://vizhub.healthdata.org/gbd-results/.
